evidence.why: Complete preload helper, cache mutations and audio call sequence.
Character/stage masks, category-bit operations, load initiation and separate wait function.

facts.rationale: The canonical caller establishes cache writes and exact arguments; the audio implementations establish bit-category handling and distinguish request initiation from completion.
facts.value: Obtains the shared DVD game cache, invokes lbDvd_80018C6C, copies four configured character/color pairs and the exposed stage value into the cache, and invokes lbDvd_80018254. Builds a u64 audio mask starting at 4, ORs character masks for entries other than CHKIND_NONE, and ORs the stage mask. Calls lbAudioAx_80026F2C with category flags 0x1E to mark the corresponding request entries -1, then lbAudioAx_8002702C with category flags 0xE and the accumulated mask to mark selected entries 1, then lbAudioAx_80027168 to initiate loading. This helper does not call the separate lbAudioAx_80027648 completion-wait API.
